headline: Eni's Ravenna CCS selected for EU Innovation Fund support
summary: Eni said its Ravenna CCS project — Italy's flagship capture-and-storage scheme, run with Snam — has been selected for a grant under the EU Innovation Fund (part of the Commission's IF24 award round), helping underwrite the move from its ~0.25 Mtpa first phase toward a Phase 2 scaling to roughly 4 Mtpa by 2030.
co2crc_note: A reference point for public co-funding of a national CCS flagship — relevant to how Australia blends grant support with a maturing storage pipeline.
extractor_note: Grant amount for Ravenna not separately confirmed in-window (Eni release announces selection; EU IF24 grant agreements due to be finalised Q1 2027). capacity_mtpa 4 = cited Phase 2 target, not an awarded/operating figure. Underlying IF24 round announced ~19 Oct; this Eni release dated 21 Oct.

headline: Höegh Evi and Aker BP win €223m EU grant for cross-border CO2 shipping-and-storage chain
summary: Höegh Evi and Aker BP secured a €223m EU Innovation Fund grant for their joint project to ship captured CO2 from north-west European emitters — via floating CO2 infrastructure and next-generation liquefied-CO2 carriers — to permanent storage in Aker BP-operated reservoirs on the Norwegian Continental Shelf.
co2crc_note: A live model for liquefied-CO2 shipping as a cross-border storage enabler — directly analogous to Australia's ambitions to import/export CO2 (Bonaparte hub, Japan-Australia chains).
extractor_note: €223m = EU Innovation Fund grant (IF24 round, announced ~19 Oct; TradeWinds report dated 21 Oct). capacity_mtpa 10 = partnership's stated initial sizing of the Atlas/Poseidon storage chain, not an awarded injection figure.

headline: Ocean Carbon Removal Watch platform launched to track the marine-CDR field
summary: A new platform, Ocean Carbon Removal Watch, launched to track marine carbon-dioxide-removal (mCDR) projects, their finance, science and governance — adding transparency infrastructure to a fast-growing but lightly scrutinised corner of the CDR market.
co2crc_note: Transparency/MRV scrutiny tooling for marine CDR — peripheral to CO2CRC's geological-storage focus but part of the wider CDR integrity debate.
extractor_note: Tracking/transparency platform launch (not a project or funding event).

headline: EU Innovation Fund awards €3.4bn to 77 net-zero projects, including its first-ever DACCS grant
summary: The European Commission's IF24 round selected 77 clean-tech projects for €3.4bn, including — for the first time — a direct-air-capture-and-storage (DACCS) project and a small modular reactor; around four CCS projects are among the winners, with grant agreements due to be finalised in Q1 2027.
co2crc_note: First EU grant for a DACCS asset is a notable removals-policy signal; the round underwrites several of the European CCS projects surfaced this week (Ravenna, Höegh/Aker BP).
extractor_note: Radar / out-of-window (announced 19 Oct, before the 21-22 Oct window). €3.4bn spans all 77 projects across every clean-tech, not CCS alone (~4 CCS winners); market-aggregate-like but recorded as the government grant pot it is.

headline: Global CCS Institute publishes Global Status of CCS 2026 report
summary: The Global CCS Institute launched its annual Global Status of CCS 2026 report, the sector's benchmark stocktake of operating and developing projects, policy and capacity worldwide.
co2crc_note: The annual global benchmark CO2CRC tracks for project-pipeline, capacity and policy trends; directly informs CO2CRC's strategic positioning.
extractor_note: Radar / out-of-window (report launched ~20 Oct, before the 21-22 Oct window). Publisher's own flagship report, not a market/policy commitment; section 'markets' chosen as closest fit for a sector status overview.
